description: The agent must: (1) Read task_input.json and the skill's operation routing table, then read generate-criteria.md + schemas.md to produce 6 narrow/specific NAS-domain criteria (each under 120 chars, no broad single-word criteria), derive the correct goal slug ('select-the-best-nas-device-for-a-4k-home-media-server-with' truncated to ≤60 chars, lowercase, hyphens only), and persist session.json, criteria.json, active-goal.json, and active-session.md. (2) Read evaluate-page.md and apply the CRITICAL per-page coverage cap rule: because the input is a roundup/overview page, the depth-over-breadth rule means criteria scores should be 0.3–0.5 for shallow mentions, so the overall relevance_score must be ≤0.65; even if 4+ criteria happen to score ≥0.7 (unlikely for a roundup), at most 3 can be flipped to covered=true in one call; criteria_relevance must contain an entry for every criterion using exact (non-rephrased) criterion strings; confidence values must be floats not strings; finding types must be hardware/research-domain types (e.g., hardware_spec, software_feature) not shopping types; event file must be written to events/ with ISO 8601 compact timestamp YYYYMMDDTHHmmssZ; session.json pages array must be updated. (3) Read create-wrap-up.md and produce wrap-up.json with recommendation=null (because only 1 page was evaluated and fewer than 2 pages is a hard null condition), update session.json status to 'finished', write latest-session.md, APPEND to history.md (preserving the pre-existing old-laptop-research-2023 entry), and update active-session.md to reflect finished status. Final output must be raw JSON with no markdown fences.
